items.R13-F1: FIXED: Collector::animated_loads is linear. The id map (id value -> IdEntry {nodes, loads per attribute name}) is built once, by id_loads, with a cancellation check every 1024 node ids; id_loads(key, name) walks the elements sharing an id ONCE per (id, attribute name) and memoises the union of their load contexts in the entry (keyed by the id as looked up, so every spelling that percent-decodes to the same id shares it); the id list is iterated by reference (the Vec clone per animation is gone) and the walk checks cancellation every 1024 elements; target_loads(doc, element, name) is the single reading of one target (shared by the parent path and the id path); animated_loads and id_loads are fallible. Work for the R13 payload (100000 sharing elements x 99000 animations in the pre-review's arithmetic) is now O(elements x attribute names).
